note: Golden cases for the bounded, event-woken MCP tool-calling loop (event_agent.py) -- driven by an event (a routed syslog line or Alertmanager alert), never by a human question, and talking to the staged MCP surface through mcp_client.McpToolset rather than calling network_tools directly (see event_agent.py's module docstring for why it does not reuse agent_loop.py).
refusal_marker: "no fault found" is a complete, acceptable answer
refusal_note: B-490 (MCP-EXPERIMENT.md S11.2, also the report prompt's own v1->v2 history) measured the failure mode this marker exists to name: a small model facing a clean result invents a plausible-sounding cause rather than report one. This prompt's declared refusal path is therefore not 'return undetermined' (report.v2's shape) or 'say what you could not check' (agent_system's shape) but an explicit permission to answer with nothing wrong found -- the vacuum a small model is measured to fill with fabrication otherwise.

cases.name: wide_then_narrow_completes
cases.source: a routable RoutingDecision (bgp_session flow) against a fake ModelCaller that calls explore_lab, then investigate_lab, then stops -- tests/test_event_agent.py's positive control
structural_properties: a wide tool (explore_lab) is called before the narrow one (investigate_lab)
investigate_lab's own finding/trustworthy fields become the ticket's record_answer, never the model's own prose
the run completes (stopped_because == "end_turn", complete is True)

cases.name: no_fault_found_is_not_overridden
cases.source: investigate_lab's own JSON payload reporting finding="no_fault_on_path" against a fake ModelCaller whose final turn writes prose speculating about a cause anyway
structural_properties: record_answer carries investigate_lab's own finding string, not the model's speculative prose
the model's speculative text is recorded only as a model_exchange, never as the ticket's answer

cases.name: trigger_fires_false_never_dispatches
cases.source: a routable RoutingDecision whose matched mnemonic has trigger.fires: false in the (injected) mnemonics table
structural_properties: no tool is called, no ticket is opened
reason names the mnemonic and states it is not cleared to fire

cases.name: investigate_lab_never_ran_no_answer
cases.source: a run that exhausts max_iterations before ever calling investigate_lab
structural_properties: the ticket carries no Answer section at all -- not an empty one, an absent one
stopped_because names the exhausted bound ("max_iterations") and complete is False
